description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: new lib/zaq/engine/connect/person_credentials.ex, explicit Engine API/actions only if trusted Person auth provenance is available, tests under test/zaq/engine/connect/ and Engine API tests. Backend functions list_available, get_own_status, put_own_authentication, revoke_own_grant, remove_own_grant and OAuth start delegation (implemented next). Final names follow existing conventions. Credential_id selects definition, never owner; derive person exclusively from trusted authenticated Actor/session context and confirm active identity. ActorNormalizer is not proof of authentication. Do not expose generic admin Connect CRUD or privileged resolver as Person read actions. Existing raw owner_id issuance entry point must reject person ownership from untrusted/general event paths; gate privileged callbacks explicitly rather than allowing a bypass. Missing person, BO User ID, machine skip_permissions flag and browser person_id cannot authorize. If no trusted Person session adapter exists, ship context functions tested with trusted boundary plus documented future adapter; do not add login/UI work or claim public endpoint readiness. Never use merge aliases from an old session as automatic permission to survivor credentials without verified session revocation/canonical identity policy.

Return allowlisted CredentialSummary/GrantStatus DTOs only: id/name/provider/auth kind/policy/status/expiration and explicitly approved provider account metadata. No raw metadata, OAuth configuration, global existence, encrypted blobs, decrypted secrets or changeset params. Disabled credentials are not configurable/listed; allow own revoke/remove of retained disabled grants via known ID for privacy/security but reject create/replace/reauthorize. Reject configuration/provider/scopes/owner/grant-ID overrides; credential binding prevents cross-credential grant access. API/JWT material allowlists follow auth kind. Validation errors are sanitized per-field codes/messages, not full secret-bearing changesets. Remove versus revoke semantics must be explicit to future UI.

Tests to add before implementation: eligibility/status matrix; nil/untrusted/spoofed/stale identity; cross-Person and cross-credential access; no global disclosure; mass assignment; write-only successful and failed submissions; disabled retained grant cleanup; org/user legacy unchanged; allowed metadata cannot contain nested secret keys; required versus optional statuses. Tests through real authorization and Engine boundary where wired.

Branches/paths validated: absent/active/expired/revoked, disabled after prior setup, repeated revoke/delete idempotency, malicious attrs, user/person ID collision. Mocking plan: no internal mocks; encryption/Repo real. Documentations to update: module auth contract, docs/services/engine.md backend operations, docs/services/system-config.md DTO/write-only policy. >=95% touched-file coverage.
title: [zaq-jrg] 5. Add authorized write-only Person credential management functions
